errors.evidence: The description of the red F1 line from x=2 onwards is incorrect. The description claims the peak is at x=2, but the actual peak is at x=5 (value approx. 85.2%). The trend is also described incorrectly; for example, from x=2 to x=3 the value increases, but the description claims it decreases. All subsequent numerical values reported are also incorrect.

The value for the blue Acc line at x=6 is approximately 75.3%, not 74%.
